description: This file defines Express.js routes for managing LLM cost records, including CRUD operations with tenant enforcement, tenant resolution, and Swagger API documentation.

methods.name: router.use
methods.description: Middleware to enforce authentication, tenant requirement, and tenant scope enforcement, as well as to set tenant-related response headers.

methods.name: router.get
methods.description: Handles GET requests for listing LLM cost records and retrieving individual records by ID.

methods.name: router.post
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create new LLM cost records.

methods.name: router.put
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update existing LLM cost records by ID.

methods.name: router.delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove LLM cost records by ID.
